messages:
Ivy Soma: hey all — ivy here, joined design today! remote in austin, usually online 10-6 CT. big into board games, bento boxes, and very caffeinated tea :chopsticks::game_die::tea:
Juno Park: welcome Ivy!! we do a weekly tabletop night on Thursdays at 7pm, bring fav snacks. also we have a bento swap shelf if you wanna trade containers :tada::bento_box:
Ivy Soma: tabletop night sounds perfect. what games do you usually bring? Im partial to cooperative stuff and anything with tiny meeples
Kai Nakamura: weve been cycling through Pandemic, Azul, and a chaotic round of Codenames last week. occasional dice-rolling chaos too :game_die:
Sam Booker: badge FYI: People Ops opens at 10:00, bring your ID. also pro tip — the 2nd-floor fridge accepts labeled bento containers (no loose liquids) :idcard::ringer_planet:
onboarding-bot: Welcome Ivy! An onboarding buddy (Juno Park) has been assigned. A calendar event "New Hire Welcome" is scheduled at 11:30. Check your DMs for orientation docs. :robot_face:
Ivy Soma: got the invite, thanks bot. quick Q: is there a designated bike rack or do folks stash bikes inside?
Juno Park: we have an outdoor bike rack (secure camera nearby) and a small indoor hook area on the bike room if youre bringing a folding bike. leave a note in #people-ops if you need a temporary pass
Kai Nakamura: lunch poll: rooftop poke bowl or ramen on 2nd? vote :poke: or :ramen:
Ivy Soma: :poke: — gotta keep that sashimi energy
Sam Booker: welcome again Ivy!! see you at the rooftop meet later. also we hide a small container of emergency soy sauce in the pantry — now you know :eyes::soy_sauce:
